ko.title: 오전 4시의 투표, 50대 49의 표 차이: 트럼프의 전 변호사는 어떻게 미국의 법무장관이 되었나

segments.src: ## A Senate Floor Nearly Empty, a Nation Watching
segments.tr: ## 거의 텅 빈 상원 회의장, 지켜보는 국민들

segments.src: Just before dawn, in a chamber thinned out by exhaustion and long past the hour most Americans had gone to sleep, the U.S.
segments.tr: 동트기 직전, 피로로 인해 텅 비어버린 회의장에서, 대부분의 미국인이 잠든 지 오래된 시간에 미

segments.src: Senate confirmed Todd Blanche as the next attorney general of the United States.
segments.tr: 상원은 토드 블랜치를 차기 미국 법무장관으로 인준했다.

segments.src: The final tally — 50 to 49 — was as narrow as confirmation votes get, and it capped weeks of stop-and-start negotiations that had, at several points, looked like they might end in defeat for the nomination.
segments.tr: 최종 득표수는 50대 49로, 인준 투표로서는 가장 근소한 차이였으며, 이는 몇 주간의 중단과 재개를 반복한 협상 끝에 나온 결과였다. 협상 과정에서 몇 번이나 지명 실패로 끝날 것처럼 보였던 상황이었다.

segments.src: Blanche's path to the country's top law enforcement post was unusual by any measure.
segments.tr: 블랜치가 미국 최고의 법 집행 기관 수장 자리에 오른 과정은 어떤 기준으로 보더라도 이례적이었다.

segments.src: Before his nomination, he was best known as one of Donald Trump's personal defense attorneys, representing the former and now-sitting president in a series of high-profile legal battles.
segments.tr: 지명되기 전, 그는 도널드 트럼프의 개인 변호인 중 한 명으로 가장 잘 알려져 있었으며, 전직이자 현직 대통령인 그를 대리하여 일련의 세간의 이목을 끄는 법적 공방을 벌였다.

segments.src: That history was always going to shape how the confirmation fight unfolded, and it did — turning what might otherwise have been a routine cabinet vote into a referendum on the independence of the Justice Department itself.
segments.tr: 그러한 이력은 인준 과정이 어떻게 전개될지를 처음부터 결정지을 수밖에 없었고, 실제로도 그랬다. 자칫 평범했을 내각 인준 투표를 법무부 자체의 독립성에 대한 국민투표로 바꿔놓은 것이다.

segments.src: ## A Long, Uneven Road to Confirmation
segments.tr: ## 길고 험난했던 인준 과정

segments.src: Support for the nomination did not move in a straight line.
segments.tr: 지명에 대한 지지는 순탄하게 이어지지 않았다.

segments.src: Momentum stalled repeatedly in committee and on the floor, as senators from both parties raised questions about how a nominee with such close personal and professional ties to the president would navigate the traditional wall between the White House and federal law enforcement.
segments.tr: 대통령과 그토록 밀접한 개인적, 직업적 관계를 맺고 있는 지명자가 어떻게 백악관과 연방 법 집행 기관 사이의 전통적인 장벽을 유지할 것인지에 대해 양당 상원의원들이 의문을 제기하면서, 위원회와 본회의에서 추진 동력은 반복적으로 멈춰 섰다.

segments.src: Two Republican senators ultimately broke with their party to vote against confirmation, a defection significant enough that it left leadership with almost no margin for additional losses.
segments.tr: 결국 두 명의 공화당 상원의원이 당론을 거스르고 인준 반대 투표를 던졌는데, 이는 지도부가 추가 이탈을 허용할 여지가 거의 없을 정도로 중대한 반란이었다.

segments.src: Those defections, according to aides familiar with the closed-door talks, centered less on Blanche's legal credentials — which supporters describe as substantial — and more on broader concerns about precedent: what it means for an attorney general to arrive at the job directly from representing the president in his own legal proceedings.
segments.tr: 비공개 회담에 정통한 보좌관들에 따르면, 이러한 이탈은 블랜치의 법률적 자질(지지자들은 이를 상당하다고 평가한다)보다는 선례에 대한 더 넓은 우려에 집중되었다. 즉, 대통령의 법적 절차를 직접 대리하던 인물이 법무장관으로 부임한다는 것이 어떤 의미인지에 대한 우려였다.

segments.src: Democrats were unanimous in opposition, framing the nomination as emblematic of a broader effort to align the Justice Department more closely with the White House's political interests.
segments.tr: 민주당은 만장일치로 반대하며, 이번 지명이 법무부를 백악관의 정치적 이익에 더 가깝게 맞추려는 광범위한 노력의 상징이라고 규정했다.

segments.src: ## Why the Vote Happened at 4 A.M.
segments.tr: ## 왜 오전 4시에 투표가 진행되었나

segments.src: The overnight timing was not incidental.
segments.tr: 심야 시간대의 투표는 우연이 아니었다.

segments.src: Senate leadership scheduled the final vote for the early morning hours after a lengthy series of procedural motions and extended floor speeches from opponents, who used the available time to press their objections on the record.
segments.tr: 상원 지도부는 일련의 긴 절차적 동의안과 반대파들의 장시간 본회의 연설이 끝난 후 새벽 시간에 최종 투표를 잡았다. 반대파들은 주어진 시간을 활용해 기록상으로 자신들의 반대 입장을 분명히 했다.

segments.src: Supporters of the nomination argued the delay tactics were more about signaling than substance, since the outcome had been effectively locked in once vote-counters secured a bare majority earlier in the week.
segments.tr: 지명 지지자들은 이미 주 초에 과반수를 확보하여 결과가 사실상 확정된 상태였기 때문에, 이러한 지연 전술은 실질적인 내용보다는 상징적인 의미가 더 컸다고 주장했다.

segments.src: Critics countered that the extraordinary hour underscored just how contested the process had become.
segments.tr: 비판자들은 이 이례적인 시간이 이번 인준 과정이 얼마나 치열하게 다투어졌는지를 보여주는 방증이라고 반박했다.

segments.src: Whatever the intent, the image of a wafer-thin majority pushing through a confirmation vote while most of the country slept has become its own story — a visual shorthand for a nomination that never enjoyed broad, comfortable support.
segments.tr: 의도가 무엇이든, 온 나라가 잠든 사이에 근소한 과반수로 인준 투표를 밀어붙이는 모습은 그 자체로 하나의 이야기가 되었다. 이는 폭넓고 편안한 지지를 전혀 받지 못한 지명에 대한 시각적 요약과도 같았다.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next for the Justice Department
segments.tr: ## 법무부의 향후 과제

segments.src: Blanche now inherits a department facing no shortage of institutional pressure, including ongoing questions about prosecutorial independence, staffing turnover, and how the office manages politically sensitive cases involving the administration itself.
segments.tr: 블랜치는 이제 기소의 독립성, 인력 교체, 그리고 행정부 자체와 관련된 정치적으로 민감한 사건들을 어떻게 관리할 것인가에 대한 지속적인 의문을 포함하여, 제도적 압박에 직면한 법무부를 물려받게 되었다.

segments.src: Legal analysts across the ideological spectrum have said the new attorney general's early decisions — particularly any involving matters connected to the president he once represented — will be closely watched as an early test of how he intends to draw, or not draw, boundaries between his past role and his new one.
segments.tr: 이념적 스펙트럼을 막론하고 법률 분석가들은 신임 법무장관의 초기 결정, 특히 그가 한때 대리했던 대통령과 관련된 사안에 대한 결정들이 그가 과거의 역할과 새로운 역할 사이의 경계를 어떻게 설정할지(혹은 설정하지 않을지)를 보여주는 초기 시험대가 될 것이라며 예의주시할 것이라고 말했다.

segments.src: Former Justice Department officials, speaking generally about the transition rather than about Blanche specifically, have noted that attorneys general who arrive with strong personal loyalties to a president often face a defining moment early in their tenure when those loyalties and the department's institutional obligations appear to pull in different directions.
segments.tr: 블랜치 개인에 대한 언급보다는 정권 교체에 대해 일반적으로 이야기하는 전직 법무부 관계자들은, 대통령에 대한 강한 개인적 충성심을 가지고 부임하는 법무장관들은 종종 임기 초기에 그러한 충성심과 법무부의 제도적 의무가 서로 다른 방향으로 당기는 결정적인 순간을 맞이한다고 지적했다.

segments.src: How that moment is handled, they say, tends to shape the rest of a tenure.
segments.tr: 그들은 그 순간을 어떻게 처리하느냐가 남은 임기의 성격을 결정짓는 경향이 있다고 말한다.

segments.src: ## A Divided Chamber, A Divided Reaction
segments.tr: ## 분열된 의회, 분열된 반응

segments.src: Reaction on Capitol Hill broke along familiar lines.
segments.tr: 국회의사당의 반응은 익숙한 노선을 따라 갈라졌다.

segments.src: Supporters of the confirmation pointed to Blanche's trial experience and argued that personal association with a president is not, on its own, disqualifying — noting that past attorneys general have also had prior political or personal ties to the administrations they served.
segments.tr: 인준 지지자들은 블랜치의 재판 경험을 강조하며 대통령과의 개인적 친분이 그 자체로 결격 사유는 아니라고 주장했다. 과거의 법무장관들도 자신이 봉사했던 행정부와 정치적 또는 개인적 인연이 있었음을 언급하면서 말이다.

segments.src: Opponents maintained that the closeness of this particular relationship, combined with the unusually narrow vote, leaves the department starting its next chapter under a cloud of skepticism it did not choose and cannot easily dispel.
segments.tr: 반대파들은 이번 관계의 밀접함과 이례적으로 근소했던 투표 결과가 결합되어, 법무부가 원치 않았고 쉽게 떨쳐낼 수 없는 회의론의 그늘 아래에서 다음 장을 시작하게 되었다고 주장했다.

segments.src: For now, the numbers speak for themselves: a single vote, cast in the small hours of the morning, was enough to install Todd Blanche as the nation's chief law enforcement officer — and enough to leave Washington debating what that margin says about the office he now leads.
segments.tr: 현재로서는 숫자가 모든 것을 말해준다. 새벽 시간에 던져진 단 한 표가 토드 블랜치를 국가의 최고 법 집행관으로 임명하기에 충분했고, 그가 이끄는 부처에 대해 그 표 차이가 무엇을 의미하는지를 워싱턴이 토론하게 만들기에 충분했다.

zh.title: 凌晨4点的投票，50比49的微弱优势：特朗普的前律师是如何成为美国司法部长的

segments.src: ## A Senate Floor Nearly Empty, a Nation Watching
segments.tr: ## 参议院大厅几乎空无一人，全国民众在关注

segments.src: Just before dawn, in a chamber thinned out by exhaustion and long past the hour most Americans had gone to sleep, the U.S.
segments.tr: 就在破晓前，在因疲惫而稀疏、且远超大多数美国人入睡时间的参议院大厅里，美国

segments.src: Senate confirmed Todd Blanche as the next attorney general of the United States.
segments.tr: 参议院确认托德·布兰奇（Todd Blanche）为下一任美国司法部长。

segments.src: The final tally — 50 to 49 — was as narrow as confirmation votes get, and it capped weeks of stop-and-start negotiations that had, at several points, looked like they might end in defeat for the nomination.
segments.tr: 最终票数——50比49——是确认投票中所能达到的最微弱差距，它为数周来走走停停的谈判画上了句号，而这些谈判在几个节点上曾一度让人觉得可能以该提名的失败而告终。

segments.src: Blanche's path to the country's top law enforcement post was unusual by any measure.
segments.tr: 无论以何种标准衡量，布兰奇通往该国最高执法职务的道路都不同寻常。

segments.src: Before his nomination, he was best known as one of Donald Trump's personal defense attorneys, representing the former and now-sitting president in a series of high-profile legal battles.
segments.tr: 在获得提名之前，他最为人所知的是唐纳德·特朗普的私人辩护律师之一，在一系列备受瞩目的法律斗争中代表这位前总统兼现任总统。

segments.src: That history was always going to shape how the confirmation fight unfolded, and it did — turning what might otherwise have been a routine cabinet vote into a referendum on the independence of the Justice Department itself.
segments.tr: 这段历史注定会塑造确认战的展开方式，事实也的确如此——它将一场原本可能是例行的内阁投票，变成了一场关于司法部本身独立性的全民公决。

segments.src: ## A Long, Uneven Road to Confirmation
segments.tr: ## 漫长而波折的确认之路

segments.src: Support for the nomination did not move in a straight line.
segments.tr: 对该提名的支持并非一帆风顺。

segments.src: Momentum stalled repeatedly in committee and on the floor, as senators from both parties raised questions about how a nominee with such close personal and professional ties to the president would navigate the traditional wall between the White House and federal law enforcement.
segments.tr: 委员会和参议院大厅里的势头屡屡陷入停滞，因为两党参议员纷纷对一个与总统有着如此密切个人和职业联系的被提名人，将如何驾驭白宫与联邦执法部门之间传统的隔阂提出质疑。

segments.src: Two Republican senators ultimately broke with their party to vote against confirmation, a defection significant enough that it left leadership with almost no margin for additional losses.
segments.tr: 最终有两名共和党参议员与本党决裂，投了反对票，这一反叛足够重大，导致领导层几乎没有容纳额外损失的余地。

segments.src: Those defections, according to aides familiar with the closed-door talks, centered less on Blanche's legal credentials — which supporters describe as substantial — and more on broader concerns about precedent: what it means for an attorney general to arrive at the job directly from representing the president in his own legal proceedings.
segments.tr: 据熟悉闭门会谈的助手透露，这些反叛与其说集中在布兰奇的法律资历上（支持者称其资历雄厚），不如说集中在对先例的更广泛担忧上：对于一位司法部长来说，直接从代表总统处理其本人的法律诉讼转而担任该职意味着什么。

segments.src: Democrats were unanimous in opposition, framing the nomination as emblematic of a broader effort to align the Justice Department more closely with the White House's political interests.
segments.tr: 民主党人则一致反对，将该提名描述为更广泛努力的象征，旨在让司法部与白宫的政治利益更加紧密地对齐。

segments.src: ## Why the Vote Happened at 4 A.M.
segments.tr: ## 为什么投票发生在凌晨4点

segments.src: The overnight timing was not incidental.
segments.tr: 夜间的时间安排并非偶然。

segments.src: Senate leadership scheduled the final vote for the early morning hours after a lengthy series of procedural motions and extended floor speeches from opponents, who used the available time to press their objections on the record.
segments.tr: 在经历了一系列冗长的程序性动议和反对者长篇大论的发言后，参议院领导层将最终投票安排在清晨进行，反对者利用宝贵的时间将他们的反对意见记录在案。

segments.src: Supporters of the nomination argued the delay tactics were more about signaling than substance, since the outcome had been effectively locked in once vote-counters secured a bare majority earlier in the week.
segments.tr: 提名的支持者认为，拖延战术更多是为了表态而非实质内容，因为一旦计票员在周早些时候确保了微弱多数，结果实际上就已经锁定。

segments.src: Critics countered that the extraordinary hour underscored just how contested the process had become.
segments.tr: 批评者则反驳说，这个不同寻常的时间恰恰凸显了这一进程的竞争有多么激烈。

segments.src: Whatever the intent, the image of a wafer-thin majority pushing through a confirmation vote while most of the country slept has become its own story — a visual shorthand for a nomination that never enjoyed broad, comfortable support.
segments.tr: 无论意图如何，在全国大部分地区都在睡觉时，以极其微弱的多数强行通过确认投票的画面本身就已经成了一个故事——这是一个从未享有广泛、舒适支持的提名的视觉缩影。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next for the Justice Department
segments.tr: ## 司法部的下一步走向

segments.src: Blanche now inherits a department facing no shortage of institutional pressure, including ongoing questions about prosecutorial independence, staffing turnover, and how the office manages politically sensitive cases involving the administration itself.
segments.tr: 布兰奇现在接管了一个面临巨大制度压力的部门，其中包括关于检察官独立性、人员流动率以及该办公室如何处理涉及行政当局本身的政治敏感案件的持续质疑。

segments.src: Legal analysts across the ideological spectrum have said the new attorney general's early decisions — particularly any involving matters connected to the president he once represented — will be closely watched as an early test of how he intends to draw, or not draw, boundaries between his past role and his new one.
segments.tr: 跨意识形态光谱的法律分析人士表示，新司法部长的早期决定——特别是任何涉及与他曾代表过的总统相关事务的决定——将被密切关注，作为他打算如何在过去的角色与新角色之间划清或不划清界限的早期考验。

segments.src: Former Justice Department officials, speaking generally about the transition rather than about Blanche specifically, have noted that attorneys general who arrive with strong personal loyalties to a president often face a defining moment early in their tenure when those loyalties and the department's institutional obligations appear to pull in different directions.
segments.tr: 前司法部官员在普遍谈论过渡而非专门针对布兰奇时指出，带着对总统的强烈个人忠诚上任的司法部长，往往在其任职早期面临一个决定性时刻，那时这些忠诚与该部门的制度义务似乎将他们拉向不同的方向。

segments.src: How that moment is handled, they say, tends to shape the rest of a tenure.
segments.tr: 他们说，这一刻的处理方式往往会塑造剩余的任期。

segments.src: ## A Divided Chamber, A Divided Reaction
segments.tr: ## 分裂的参议院，分裂的反应

segments.src: Reaction on Capitol Hill broke along familiar lines.
segments.tr: 国会山上的反应沿循着熟悉的路线分裂。

segments.src: Supporters of the confirmation pointed to Blanche's trial experience and argued that personal association with a president is not, on its own, disqualifying — noting that past attorneys general have also had prior political or personal ties to the administrations they served.
segments.tr: 确认的支持者指出布兰奇的审判经验，并认为与总统的个人关联本身并不能剥夺资格——他们指出过去的司法部长与他们服务的政府也有过先前的政治或个人联系。

fr.title: Un vote à 4h du matin, une marge de 50 contre 49 : comment l'ancien avocat de Trump est devenu le procureur général des États-Unis

segments.src: ## A Senate Floor Nearly Empty, a Nation Watching

segments.src: Just before dawn, in a chamber thinned out by exhaustion and long past the hour most Americans had gone to sleep, the U.S.
segments.tr: Juste avant l'aube, dans une salle vidée par l'épuisement et bien après l'heure où la plupart des Américains s'étaient endormis, le Sénat des États-Unis

segments.src: Senate confirmed Todd Blanche as the next attorney general of the United States.
segments.tr: a confirmé Todd Blanche au poste de prochain procureur général des États-Unis.

segments.src: The final tally — 50 to 49 — was as narrow as confirmation votes get, and it capped weeks of stop-and-start negotiations that had, at several points, looked like they might end in defeat for the nomination.
segments.tr: Le décompte final — 50 contre 49 — a été aussi serré qu'un vote de confirmation puisse l'être, et il a couronné des semaines de négociations en dents de scie qui, à plusieurs moments, auraient pu se solder par un échec pour la nomination.

segments.src: Blanche's path to the country's top law enforcement post was unusual by any measure.
segments.tr: Le parcours de Blanche vers le plus haut poste de l'application de la loi du pays était inhabituel à tous égards.

segments.src: Before his nomination, he was best known as one of Donald Trump's personal defense attorneys, representing the former and now-sitting president in a series of high-profile legal battles.
segments.tr: Avant sa nomination, il était surtout connu comme l'un des avocats de la défense personnelle de Donald Trump, représentant l'ancien et désormais actuel président dans une série de batailles juridiques très médiatisées.

segments.src: That history was always going to shape how the confirmation fight unfolded, and it did — turning what might otherwise have been a routine cabinet vote into a referendum on the independence of the Justice Department itself.
segments.tr: Cet historique allait inévitablement façonner le déroulement de la lutte pour la confirmation, ce qui fut le cas — transformant ce qui aurait pu être un vote de cabinet de routine en un référendum sur l'indépendance du ministère de la Justice lui-même.

segments.src: ## A Long, Uneven Road to Confirmation
segments.tr: ## Un chemin long et irrégulier vers la confirmation

segments.src: Support for the nomination did not move in a straight line.
segments.tr: Le soutien à la nomination n'a pas progressé de manière linéaire.

segments.src: Momentum stalled repeatedly in committee and on the floor, as senators from both parties raised questions about how a nominee with such close personal and professional ties to the president would navigate the traditional wall between the White House and federal law enforcement.
segments.tr: L'élan a calé à plusieurs reprises en commission et dans l'hémicycle, alors que des sénateurs des deux partis soulevaient des questions sur la manière dont un candidat ayant des liens personnels et professionnels aussi étroits avec le président naviguerait sur le mur traditionnel entre la Maison Blanche et les forces de l'ordre fédérales.

segments.src: Two Republican senators ultimately broke with their party to vote against confirmation, a defection significant enough that it left leadership with almost no margin for additional losses.
segments.tr: Deux sénateurs républicains ont finalement rompu avec leur parti pour voter contre la confirmation, une dissidence suffisamment importante pour laisser la direction avec presque aucune marge pour des pertes supplémentaires.

segments.src: Those defections, according to aides familiar with the closed-door talks, centered less on Blanche's legal credentials — which supporters describe as substantial — and more on broader concerns about precedent: what it means for an attorney general to arrive at the job directly from representing the president in his own legal proceedings.
segments.tr: Ces dissidences, selon des conseillers familiers avec les pourparlers à huis clos, se sont moins concentrées sur les qualifications juridiques de Blanche — que les partisans décrivent comme substantielles — que sur des préoccupations plus larges concernant le préméditation ou le précédent : ce que cela signifie pour un procureur général d'arriver au poste directement après avoir représenté le président dans ses propres procédures judiciaires.

segments.src: Democrats were unanimous in opposition, framing the nomination as emblematic of a broader effort to align the Justice Department more closely with the White House's political interests.
segments.tr: Les démocrates ont fait preuve d'une opposition unanime, qualifiant la nomination d'emblématique d'un effort plus large pour aligner plus étroitement le ministère de la Justice sur les intérêts politiques de la Maison Blanche.

segments.src: ## Why the Vote Happened at 4 A.M.
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi le vote a eu lieu à 4 heures du matin

segments.src: The overnight timing was not incidental.
segments.tr: Le choix du moment nocturne n'était pas fortuit.

segments.src: Senate leadership scheduled the final vote for the early morning hours after a lengthy series of procedural motions and extended floor speeches from opponents, who used the available time to press their objections on the record.
segments.tr: La direction du Sénat a programmé le vote final pour les premières heures de la matinée après une longue série de motions procédurales et de longs discours dans l'hémicycle de la part des opposants, qui ont profité du temps disponible pour consigner leurs objections.

segments.src: Supporters of the nomination argued the delay tactics were more about signaling than substance, since the outcome had been effectively locked in once vote-counters secured a bare majority earlier in the week.
segments.tr: Les partisans de la nomination ont soutenu que les tactiques de retardement relevaient davantage de la signalisation que du fond, l'issue ayant été effectivement scellée une fois que les compteurs de voix ont obtenu une courte majorité plus tôt dans la semaine.

segments.src: Critics countered that the extraordinary hour underscored just how contested the process had become.
segments.tr: Les critiques ont rétorqué que cette heure extraordinaire soulignait à quel point le processus était devenu contesté.

segments.src: Whatever the intent, the image of a wafer-thin majority pushing through a confirmation vote while most of the country slept has become its own story — a visual shorthand for a nomination that never enjoyed broad, comfortable support.
segments.tr: Quelle qu'ait été l'intention, l'image d'une majorité très mince faisant passer un vote de confirmation pendant que la majeure partie du pays dormait est devenue sa propre histoire — un raccourci visuel pour une nomination qui n'a jamais bénéficié d'un soutien large et confortable.

segments.src: Former Justice Department officials, speaking generally about the transition rather than about Blanche specifically, have noted that attorneys general who arrive with strong personal loyalties to a president often face a defining moment early in their tenure when those loyalties and the department's institutional obligations appear to pull in different directions.
segments.tr: D'anciens responsables du ministère de la Justice, s'exprimant de manière générale sur la transition plutôt que sur Blanche en particulier, ont noté que les procureurs généraux qui arrivent avec de fortes loyautés personnelles envers un président font souvent face à un moment décisif au début de leur mandat lorsque ces loyautés et les obligations institutionnelles du département semblent tirer dans des directions différentes.

segments.src: For now, the numbers speak for themselves: a single vote, cast in the small hours of the morning, was enough to install Todd Blanche as the nation's chief law enforcement officer — and enough to leave Washington debating what that margin says about the office he now leads.
segments.tr: Pour l'instant, les chiffres parlent d'eux-mêmes : un seul vote, exprimé aux petites heures du matin, a suffi pour installer Todd Blanche comme le principal agent d'application de la loi de la nation — et assez pour laisser Washington débattre de ce que cette marge dit du bureau qu'il dirige désormais.

segments.src: Support for the nomination did not move in a straight line.
segments.tr: Dukungan untuk nominasi tersebut tidak bergerak dalam garis lurus.

segments.src: Momentum stalled repeatedly in committee and on the floor, as senators from both parties raised questions about how a nominee with such close personal and professional ties to the president would navigate the traditional wall between the White House and federal law enforcement.
segments.tr: Momentum terhenti berulang kali di komite dan di lantai sidang, karena senator dari kedua partai mengajukan pertanyaan tentang bagaimana seorang calon dengan hubungan pribadi dan profesional yang begitu dekat dengan presiden akan menavigasi tembok tradisional antara Gedung Putih dan penegak hukum federal.

segments.src: Two Republican senators ultimately broke with their party to vote against confirmation, a defection significant enough that it left leadership with almost no margin for additional losses.
segments.tr: Dua senator Republik akhirnya memisahkan diri dari partai mereka untuk memberikan suara menentang konfirmasi, sebuah pembelotan yang cukup signifikan sehingga membuat kepemimpinan hampir tidak memiliki margin untuk kehilangan suara tambahan.

segments.src: Those defections, according to aides familiar with the closed-door talks, centered less on Blanche's legal credentials — which supporters describe as substantial — and more on broader concerns about precedent: what it means for an attorney general to arrive at the job directly from representing the president in his own legal proceedings.
segments.tr: Pembelotan tersebut, menurut para pembantu yang akrab dengan pembicaraan tertutup, lebih berpusat pada kekhawatiran yang lebih luas tentang preseden daripada kredensial hukum Blanche — yang digambarkan oleh para pendukungnya sebagai substansial —: apa artinya bagi seorang jaksa agung untuk langsung menjabat setelah mewakili presiden dalam proses hukumnya sendiri.

segments.src: Democrats were unanimous in opposition, framing the nomination as emblematic of a broader effort to align the Justice Department more closely with the White House's political interests.
segments.tr: Partai Demokrat dengan suara bulat menentang, membingkai nominasi tersebut sebagai lambang upaya yang lebih luas untuk menyelaraskan Departemen Kehakiman lebih dekat dengan kepentingan politik Gedung Putih.

segments.src: ## Why the Vote Happened at 4 A.M.
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Pemungutan Suara Terjadi pada Pukul 4 Pagi

segments.src: The overnight timing was not incidental.
segments.tr: Waktu dini hari itu bukan kebetulan.

segments.src: Senate leadership scheduled the final vote for the early morning hours after a lengthy series of procedural motions and extended floor speeches from opponents, who used the available time to press their objections on the record.
segments.tr: Kepemimpinan Senat menjadwalkan pemungutan suara akhir pada jam-jam awal pagi setelah serangkaian mosi prosedural yang panjang dan pidato panjang lebar dari pihak lawan, yang menggunakan waktu yang tersedia untuk menyampaikan keberatan mereka secara resmi.

segments.src: Supporters of the nomination argued the delay tactics were more about signaling than substance, since the outcome had been effectively locked in once vote-counters secured a bare majority earlier in the week.
segments.tr: Para pendukung nominasi berpendapat bahwa taktik penundaan lebih tentang memberi sinyal daripada substansi, karena hasilnya telah terkunci secara efektif begitu penghitung suara mengamankan mayoritas tipis di awal minggu.

segments.src: Critics countered that the extraordinary hour underscored just how contested the process had become.
segments.tr: Para kritikus membalas bahwa jam yang luar biasa itu menggarisbawahi betapa sengitnya proses tersebut.

segments.src: Whatever the intent, the image of a wafer-thin majority pushing through a confirmation vote while most of the country slept has become its own story — a visual shorthand for a nomination that never enjoyed broad, comfortable support.
segments.tr: Apa pun niatnya, gambaran tentang mayoritas yang sangat tipis yang mendorong pemungutan suara konfirmasi saat sebagian besar negara tertidur telah menjadi ceritanya sendiri — sebuah singkatan visual untuk nominasi yang tidak pernah menikmati dukungan luas dan nyaman.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next for the Justice Department
segments.tr: ## Apa Selanjutnya untuk Departemen Kehakiman

segments.src: Blanche now inherits a department facing no shortage of institutional pressure, including ongoing questions about prosecutorial independence, staffing turnover, and how the office manages politically sensitive cases involving the administration itself.
segments.tr: Blanche sekarang mewarisi departemen yang menghadapi tekanan institusional yang tidak sedikit, termasuk pertanyaan yang sedang berlangsung tentang independensi penuntutan, pergantian staf, dan bagaimana kantor tersebut mengelola kasus-kasus sensitif secara politik yang melibatkan pemerintahan itu sendiri.

segments.src: Legal analysts across the ideological spectrum have said the new attorney general's early decisions — particularly any involving matters connected to the president he once represented — will be closely watched as an early test of how he intends to draw, or not draw, boundaries between his past role and his new one.
segments.tr: Analis hukum di seluruh spektrum ideologis mengatakan keputusan awal jaksa agung baru — terutama yang melibatkan masalah yang terkait dengan presiden yang pernah ia wakili — akan diawasi dengan ketat sebagai ujian awal tentang bagaimana ia bermaksud untuk menarik, atau tidak menarik, batasan antara peran masa lalunya dan peran barunya.

segments.src: Former Justice Department officials, speaking generally about the transition rather than about Blanche specifically, have noted that attorneys general who arrive with strong personal loyalties to a president often face a defining moment early in their tenure when those loyalties and the department's institutional obligations appear to pull in different directions.
segments.tr: Mantan pejabat Departemen Kehakiman, yang berbicara secara umum tentang transisi daripada tentang Blanche secara khusus, telah mencatat bahwa jaksa agung yang datang dengan loyalitas pribadi yang kuat kepada seorang presiden sering menghadapi momen penentu di awal masa jabatan mereka ketika loyalitas tersebut dan kewajiban institusional departemen tampak menarik ke arah yang berbeda.

segments.src: How that moment is handled, they say, tends to shape the rest of a tenure.
segments.tr: Bagaimana momen itu ditangani, kata mereka, cenderung membentuk sisa masa jabatan.

segments.src: ## A Divided Chamber, A Divided Reaction
segments.tr: ## Kamar yang Terpecah, Reaksi yang Terpecah

segments.src: Reaction on Capitol Hill broke along familiar lines.
segments.tr: Reaksi di Capitol Hill terpecah di sepanjang garis yang sudah dikenal.

segments.src: Supporters of the confirmation pointed to Blanche's trial experience and argued that personal association with a president is not, on its own, disqualifying — noting that past attorneys general have also had prior political or personal ties to the administrations they served.
segments.tr: Para pendukung konfirmasi menunjuk pada pengalaman persidangan Blanche dan berpendapat bahwa hubungan pribadi dengan seorang presiden, dengan sendirinya, tidak mendiskualifikasi — mencatat bahwa jaksa agung masa lalu juga memiliki hubungan politik atau pribadi sebelumnya dengan pemerintahan yang mereka layani.

segments.src: Opponents maintained that the closeness of this particular relationship, combined with the unusually narrow vote, leaves the department starting its next chapter under a cloud of skepticism it did not choose and cannot easily dispel.
segments.tr: Para penentang berpendapat bahwa kedekatan hubungan khusus ini, dikombinasikan dengan pemungutan suara yang sangat sempit, membuat departemen memulai bab berikutnya di bawah awan skeptisisme yang tidak dipilihnya dan tidak dapat dengan mudah dihilangkan.

segments.src: For now, the numbers speak for themselves: a single vote, cast in the small hours of the morning, was enough to install Todd Blanche as the nation's chief law enforcement officer — and enough to leave Washington debating what that margin says about the office he now leads.
segments.tr: Untuk saat ini, angka-angka berbicara sendiri: satu suara, yang diberikan pada dini hari, cukup untuk melantik Todd Blanche sebagai kepala penegak hukum negara — dan cukup untuk membuat Washington memperdebatkan apa arti margin tersebut bagi kantor yang kini ia pimpin.

segments.src: ## A Senate Floor Nearly Empty, a Nation Watching
segments.tr: ## ほぼ無人の上院議場、見守る国家

segments.src: Just before dawn, in a chamber thinned out by exhaustion and long past the hour most Americans had gone to sleep, the U.S.
segments.tr: 夜明け直前、疲労によって議員が減り、大半のアメリカ人が眠りについた時間を遠く過ぎた頃、米

segments.src: Senate confirmed Todd Blanche as the next attorney general of the United States.
segments.tr: 上院はトッド・ブランシュを次期米国司法長官として承認した。

segments.src: The final tally — 50 to 49 — was as narrow as confirmation votes get, and it capped weeks of stop-and-start negotiations that had, at several points, looked like they might end in defeat for the nomination.
segments.tr: 最終的な集計結果である50対49は、承認採決としてはこれ以上ないほど僅差であり、何度も中断と再開を繰り返した数週間の交渉の末に決着した。交渉の過程では、いくつかの時点で指名が否決に終わる可能性さえ示唆されていた。

segments.src: Blanche's path to the country's top law enforcement post was unusual by any measure.
segments.tr: ブランシュが国の最高法執行ポストに就くまでの道のりは、いかなる基準から見ても異例であった。

segments.src: Before his nomination, he was best known as one of Donald Trump's personal defense attorneys, representing the former and now-sitting president in a series of high-profile legal battles.
segments.tr: 指名される前、彼はドナルド・トランプの個人的弁護団の一人として最もよく知られており、数々の注目を集める法的闘争において元大統領、そして現職大統領の弁護を務めていた。

segments.src: That history was always going to shape how the confirmation fight unfolded, and it did — turning what might otherwise have been a routine cabinet vote into a referendum on the independence of the Justice Department itself.
segments.tr: その経歴が承認闘争の展開を形作ることは最初から予想されており、実際にその通りになった。本来であればルーチンであるべき内閣人事の採決が、司法省自体の独立性に関する国民投票へと変貌を遂げたのである。

segments.src: ## A Long, Uneven Road to Confirmation
segments.tr: ## 長く平坦ではない承認への道のり

segments.src: Support for the nomination did not move in a straight line.
segments.tr: 指名に対する支持は一直線には進まなかった。

segments.src: Momentum stalled repeatedly in committee and on the floor, as senators from both parties raised questions about how a nominee with such close personal and professional ties to the president would navigate the traditional wall between the White House and federal law enforcement.
segments.tr: 委員会や本会議では勢いが何度も停滞した。両党の上院議員から、大統領とこれほど個人的・仕事上の結びつきが強い候補者が、ホワイトハウスと連邦法執行機関の間の伝統的な壁をいかにして乗り越えるのかという疑問の声が上がったためである。

segments.src: Two Republican senators ultimately broke with their party to vote against confirmation, a defection significant enough that it left leadership with almost no margin for additional losses.
segments.tr: 最終的に2人の共和党議員が党方針に背いて承認反対票を投じた。この離反は、指導部に追加の票を失う余裕をほとんど残さないほど重大なものだった。

segments.src: Those defections, according to aides familiar with the closed-door talks, centered less on Blanche's legal credentials — which supporters describe as substantial — and more on broader concerns about precedent: what it means for an attorney general to arrive at the job directly from representing the president in his own legal proceedings.
segments.tr: 非公開の協議に詳しい補佐官らによれば、こうした離反の焦点は、ブランシュの法的資質（支持者らは十分なものと評している）そのものというよりも、先例に関するより広範な懸念にあった。すなわち、大統領自身の法的手続きの弁護人から直接その職に就くことが、司法長官にとって何を意味するのかという点である。

segments.src: Democrats were unanimous in opposition, framing the nomination as emblematic of a broader effort to align the Justice Department more closely with the White House's political interests.
segments.tr: 民主党は全員一致で反対し、この指名を司法省をホワイトハウスの政治的利益により密接に同調させようとする広範な試みの象徴であると位置づけた。

segments.src: ## Why the Vote Happened at 4 A.M.
segments.tr: ## なぜ午前4時に採決が行われたのか

segments.src: The overnight timing was not incidental.
segments.tr: 深夜の時間帯は偶然ではなかった。

segments.src: Senate leadership scheduled the final vote for the early morning hours after a lengthy series of procedural motions and extended floor speeches from opponents, who used the available time to press their objections on the record.
segments.tr: 上院指導部は、一連の長い手続き上の動議や反対派による長時間の演説の後、早朝の時間帯に最終採決を設定した。反対派は利用可能な時間を使って、公式に異議を唱えたのである。

segments.src: Supporters of the nomination argued the delay tactics were more about signaling than substance, since the outcome had been effectively locked in once vote-counters secured a bare majority earlier in the week.
segments.tr: 指名の支持者らは、遅延戦術は実質的な意味よりも姿勢を示すためのものだと主張した。週の早い段階で票読み要員がかろうじて過半数を確保した時点で、結果は実質的に決まっていたからである。

segments.src: Critics countered that the extraordinary hour underscored just how contested the process had become.
segments.tr: これに対し批判派は、この異例の時間が、いかにプロセスが紛糾していたかを浮き彫りにしていると反論した。

segments.src: Whatever the intent, the image of a wafer-thin majority pushing through a confirmation vote while most of the country slept has become its own story — a visual shorthand for a nomination that never enjoyed broad, comfortable support.
segments.tr: 意図がどうであれ、国民の大部分が眠っている間に、紙一重の過半数が承認採決を強行したという光景それ自体が物語となった。それは、広範で安心できる支持を一度も得られなかった指名を視覚的に象徴するものであった。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next for the Justice Department
segments.tr: ## 司法省の今後の行方

segments.src: Blanche now inherits a department facing no shortage of institutional pressure, including ongoing questions about prosecutorial independence, staffing turnover, and how the office manages politically sensitive cases involving the administration itself.
segments.tr: ブランシュは現在、制度的圧力に事欠かない部署を引き継ぐことになった。そこには、検察の独立性、スタッフの離職率、そして政権自身に関わる政治的に繊細な事件をどのように管理するのかといった、継続的な疑問が含まれている。

segments.src: Legal analysts across the ideological spectrum have said the new attorney general's early decisions — particularly any involving matters connected to the president he once represented — will be closely watched as an early test of how he intends to draw, or not draw, boundaries between his past role and his new one.
segments.tr: イデオロギーの枠を超えた法制アナリストらは、新司法長官の初期の決定、特にかつて弁護した大統領に関連する問題に関わるものは、過去の役割と新しい役割の間にどのように境界線を引くつもりであるか（あるいは引かないのか）を示す初期の試金石として、厳しく監視されるだろうと述べている。

segments.src: Former Justice Department officials, speaking generally about the transition rather than about Blanche specifically, have noted that attorneys general who arrive with strong personal loyalties to a president often face a defining moment early in their tenure when those loyalties and the department's institutional obligations appear to pull in different directions.
segments.tr: ブランシュ個人についてではなく移行全般について語る元司法省高官らは、大統領に対して強い個人的忠誠心を持って就任する司法長官は、その忠誠心と司法省の制度的義務が相反する方向へ引っ張られているように見える決定的な瞬間に、任期初期の段階で直面することが多いと指摘している。

segments.src: How that moment is handled, they say, tends to shape the rest of a tenure.
segments.tr: その瞬間をどのように処理するかによって、残りの任期のあり方が形作られる傾向があると彼らは言う。

segments.src: ## A Divided Chamber, A Divided Reaction

segments.tr: 国会議事堂（カピトール）での反応は、おなじみの対立軸に沿って分かれた。

segments.src: Supporters of the confirmation pointed to Blanche's trial experience and argued that personal association with a president is not, on its own, disqualifying — noting that past attorneys general have also had prior political or personal ties to the administrations they served.
segments.tr: 承認の支持者らはブランシュの裁判経験を指摘し、大統領との個人的な結びつきはそれ自体が失格事由にはならないと主張した。過去の司法長官らも、仕えた政権と事前に政治的または個人的なつながりを持っていた例があることを挙げている。

segments.src: Opponents maintained that the closeness of this particular relationship, combined with the unusually narrow vote, leaves the department starting its next chapter under a cloud of skepticism it did not choose and cannot easily dispel.
segments.tr: 反対派は、この特定の関係の近さが、異例の僅差の投票と相まって、司法省が自ら選んだわけではなく容易には払拭できない懐疑の雲に覆われた状態で次の章を始めることになると主張し続けた。

segments.src: For now, the numbers speak for themselves: a single vote, cast in the small hours of the morning, was enough to install Todd Blanche as the nation's chief law enforcement officer — and enough to leave Washington debating what that margin says about the office he now leads.
segments.tr: 現時点では、数字がすべてを物語っている。深夜のわずかな時間に投じられた1票が、トッド・ブランシュを国の最高法執行官に据えるのに十分であり、同時に、その僅差が彼が率いる組織について何を物語っているのかをワシントンに議論させるのに十分であった。

segments.tr: ## Was als Nächstes für das Justizministerium kommt

segments.src: Blanche now inherits a department facing no shortage of institutional pressure, including ongoing questions about prosecutorial independence, staffing turnover, and how the office manages politically sensitive cases involving the administration itself.
segments.tr: Blanche übernimmt nun ein Ministerium, das sich mit einer Fülle von institutionellem Druck konfrontiert sieht, darunter anhaltende Fragen zur Unabhängigkeit der Staatsanwaltschaft, Fluktuation beim Personal und wie das Amt politisch sensible Fälle im Zusammenhang mit der Regierung selbst handhabt.

segments.src: Legal analysts across the ideological spectrum have said the new attorney general's early decisions — particularly any involving matters connected to the president he once represented — will be closely watched as an early test of how he intends to draw, or not draw, boundaries between his past role and his new one.
segments.tr: Rechtsexperten aus dem gesamten ideologischen Spektrum haben erklärt, dass die ersten Entscheidungen des neuen Justizminister — insbesondere alle Angelegenheiten im Zusammenhang mit dem Präsidenten, den er einst vertrat — genau beobachtet werden als erster Test dafür, wie er beabsichtigt, Grenzen zwischen seiner früheren und seiner neuen Rolle zu ziehen oder eben nicht.

segments.src: Former Justice Department officials, speaking generally about the transition rather than about Blanche specifically, have noted that attorneys general who arrive with strong personal loyalties to a president often face a defining moment early in their tenure when those loyalties and the department's institutional obligations appear to pull in different directions.
segments.tr: Ehemalige Beamte des Justizministeriums, die sich allgemein zum Übergang und nicht speziell zu Blanche äußerten, haben angemerkt, dass Justizminister, die mit starken persönlichen Loyalitäten zu einem Präsidenten antreten, oft zu Beginn ihrer Amtszeit vor einem entscheidenden Moment stehen, in dem diese Loyalitäten und die institutionellen Verpflichtungen des Ministeriums in unterschiedliche Richtungen zu ziehen scheinen.

segments.src: How that moment is handled, they say, tends to shape the rest of a tenure.
segments.tr: Wie mit diesem Moment umgegangen wird, prägt tendenziell den Rest einer Amtszeit.

segments.src: ## A Divided Chamber, A Divided Reaction
segments.tr: ## Ein geteilter Senat, eine geteilte Reaktion

segments.src: Reaction on Capitol Hill broke along familiar lines.
segments.tr: Die Reaktion auf dem Capitol Hill verlief entlang bekannter Linien.

segments.src: Supporters of the confirmation pointed to Blanche's trial experience and argued that personal association with a president is not, on its own, disqualifying — noting that past attorneys general have also had prior political or personal ties to the administrations they served.
segments.tr: Befürworter der Bestätigung verwiesen auf Blanches Prozesserfahrung und argumentierten, dass eine persönliche Verbindung zu einem Präsidenten für sich genommen kein Ausschlusskriterium sei — und wiesen darauf hin, dass auch frühere Justizminister bereits politische oder persönliche Verbindungen zu den Regierungen hatten, denen sie dienten.

segments.src: Opponents maintained that the closeness of this particular relationship, combined with the unusually narrow vote, leaves the department starting its next chapter under a cloud of skepticism it did not choose and cannot easily dispel.
segments.tr: Gegner beharrten darauf, dass die Enge dieser speziellen Beziehung in Verbindung mit der ungewöhnlich knappen Abstimmung dazu führt, dass das Ministerium sein nächstes Kapitel unter einem Schatten der Skepsis beginnt, den es sich nicht ausgesucht hat und nicht leicht abschütteln kann.

segments.src: For now, the numbers speak for themselves: a single vote, cast in the small hours of the morning, was enough to install Todd Blanche as the nation's chief law enforcement officer — and enough to leave Washington debating what that margin says about the office he now leads.
segments.tr: Für den Moment sprechen die Zahlen für sich: Eine einzige Stimme, abgegeben in den frühen Morgenstunden, reichte aus, um Todd Blanche zum obersten Strafverfolgungsbeamten der Nation zu machen — und reichte aus, um Washington darüber debattieren zu lassen, was diese Marge über das Amt aussagt, das er nun leitet.

vi.title: Cuộc bỏ phiếu lúc 4 giờ sáng, khoảng cách 50-49: Luật sư cũ của Trump đã trở thành Tổng biện lý Hoa Kỳ như thế nào

segments.src: ## A Senate Floor Nearly Empty, a Nation Watching
segments.tr: ## Một phòng họp Thượng viện gần như trống vắng, cả nước đang dõi theo

segments.src: Just before dawn, in a chamber thinned out by exhaustion and long past the hour most Americans had gone to sleep, the U.S.
segments.tr: Ngay trước bình minh, trong một căn phòng đã vắng đi vì kiệt sức và đã qua xa thời điểm hầu hết người Mỹ đi ngủ, Thượng viện

segments.src: Senate confirmed Todd Blanche as the next attorney general of the United States.
segments.tr: Hoa Kỳ đã chuẩn thuận Todd Blanche làm tổng biện lý tiếp theo của Hoa Kỳ.

segments.src: The final tally — 50 to 49 — was as narrow as confirmation votes get, and it capped weeks of stop-and-start negotiations that had, at several points, looked like they might end in defeat for the nomination.
segments.tr: Kết quả kiểm phiếu cuối cùng — 50 trên 49 — sát nút như các cuộc bỏ phiếu chuẩn thuận có thể xảy ra, và nó khép lại nhiều tuần đàm phán ngắt quãng mà vào một số thời điểm, tưởng chừng có thể kết thúc trong thất bại cho đề cử này.

segments.src: Blanche's path to the country's top law enforcement post was unusual by any measure.
segments.tr: Con đường dẫn đến chức vụ thực thi pháp luật cao nhất đất nước của Blanche là điều bất thường theo bất kỳ tiêu chuẩn nào.

segments.src: Before his nomination, he was best known as one of Donald Trump's personal defense attorneys, representing the former and now-sitting president in a series of high-profile legal battles.
segments.tr: Trước khi được đề cử, ông nổi tiếng nhất với tư cách là một trong những luật sư bào chữa cá nhân của Donald Trump, đại diện cho cựu tổng thống và hiện là đương kim tổng thống trong một loạt các cuộc chiến pháp lý thu hút nhiều sự chú ý.

segments.src: That history was always going to shape how the confirmation fight unfolded, and it did — turning what might otherwise have been a routine cabinet vote into a referendum on the independence of the Justice Department itself.
segments.tr: Lịch sử đó chắc chắn sẽ định hình cách cuộc chiến chuẩn thuận diễn ra, và quả thực là vậy — biến thứ vốn dĩ có thể là một cuộc bỏ phiếu nội các thông thường thành một cuộc trưng cầu dân ý về tính độc lập của chính Bộ Tư pháp.

segments.src: ## A Long, Uneven Road to Confirmation
segments.tr: ## Một con đường dài và gập ghềnh để được chuẩn thuận

segments.src: Support for the nomination did not move in a straight line.
segments.tr: Sự ủng hộ dành cho đề cử không diễn ra theo một đường thẳng.

segments.src: Momentum stalled repeatedly in committee and on the floor, as senators from both parties raised questions about how a nominee with such close personal and professional ties to the president would navigate the traditional wall between the White House and federal law enforcement.
segments.tr: Đà ủng hộ liên tục đình trệ tại ủy ban và tại phòng họp, khi các thượng nghị sĩ từ cả hai đảng đặt câu hỏi về việc một người được đề cử có mối quan hệ cá nhân và nghề nghiệp quá gần gũi với tổng thống sẽ điều hướng bức tường truyền thống giữa Tòa Bạch Ốc và cơ quan thực thi pháp luật liên bang như thế nào.

segments.src: Two Republican senators ultimately broke with their party to vote against confirmation, a defection significant enough that it left leadership with almost no margin for additional losses.
segments.tr: Cuối cùng, hai thượng nghị sĩ đảng Cộng hòa đã phá vỡ lập trường của đảng mình để bỏ phiếu chống lại việc chuẩn thuận, một sự phản bội đủ lớn để khiến giới lãnh đạo gần như không còn biên độ cho những tổn thất bổ sung.

segments.src: Those defections, according to aides familiar with the closed-door talks, centered less on Blanche's legal credentials — which supporters describe as substantial — and more on broader concerns about precedent: what it means for an attorney general to arrive at the job directly from representing the president in his own legal proceedings.
segments.tr: Những sự đào ngũ đó, theo các phụ tá quen thuộc với các cuộc đàm phán kín, ít tập trung vào năng lực pháp lý của Blanche — thứ mà những người ủng hộ mô tả là đáng kể — mà tập trung nhiều hơn vào những lo ngại rộng lớn hơn về tiền lệ: ý nghĩa của việc một tổng biện lý bước vào công việc trực tiếp từ việc đại diện cho tổng thống trong các thủ tục tố tụng pháp lý của chính ông.

segments.src: Democrats were unanimous in opposition, framing the nomination as emblematic of a broader effort to align the Justice Department more closely with the White House's political interests.
segments.tr: Đảng Dân chủ đã đồng lòng phản đối, coi đề cử này là biểu tượng cho nỗ lực rộng lớn hơn nhằm gắn kết Bộ Tư pháp chặt chẽ hơn với các lợi ích chính trị của Tòa Bạch Ốc.

segments.src: ## Why the Vote Happened at 4 A.M.
segments.tr: ## Tại sao cuộc bỏ phiếu diễn ra vào lúc 4 giờ sáng

segments.src: The overnight timing was not incidental.
segments.tr: Thời điểm ban đêm không phải là ngẫu nhiên.

segments.src: Senate leadership scheduled the final vote for the early morning hours after a lengthy series of procedural motions and extended floor speeches from opponents, who used the available time to press their objections on the record.
segments.tr: Lãnh đạo Thượng viện đã lên lịch bỏ phiếu cuối cùng vào những giờ sáng sớm sau một loạt các động thái thủ tục kéo dài và các bài phát biểu kéo dài tại phòng họp từ những người phản đối, những người đã tận dụng thời gian có sẵn để đưa ra các phản đối của họ vào biên bản.

segments.src: Supporters of the nomination argued the delay tactics were more about signaling than substance, since the outcome had been effectively locked in once vote-counters secured a bare majority earlier in the week.
segments.tr: Những người ủng hộ đề cử lập luận rằng các chiến thuật trì hoãn thiên về báo hiệu hơn là bản chất, vì kết quả thực tế đã được khóa chặt sau khi những người kiểm phiếu đảm bảo được thế đa số sít sao vào đầu tuần.

segments.src: Critics countered that the extraordinary hour underscored just how contested the process had become.
segments.tr: Những người chỉ trích phản bác rằng thời điểm phi thường đó nhấn mạnh quá trình này đã trở nên tranh cãi như thế nào.

segments.src: Whatever the intent, the image of a wafer-thin majority pushing through a confirmation vote while most of the country slept has become its own story — a visual shorthand for a nomination that never enjoyed broad, comfortable support.
segments.tr: Dù ý định là gì, hình ảnh của một thế đa số mỏng như tờ giấy thúc đẩy một cuộc bỏ phiếu chuẩn thuận trong khi phần lớn đất nước đang ngủ đã trở thành câu chuyện của riêng nó — một cách viết tắt trực quan cho một đề cử chưa bao giờ có được sự ủng hộ rộng rãi, thoải mái.

segments.tr: ## Điều gì tiếp theo cho Bộ Tư pháp

segments.tr: Các cựu quan chức Bộ Tư pháp, phát biểu chung về quá trình chuyển đổi thay vì về riêng Blanche, đã lưu ý rằng các tổng biện lý đến với lòng trung thành cá nhân mạnh mẽ đối với một tổng thống thường phải đối mặt với một thời điểm quyết định vào đầu nhiệm kỳ của họ khi lòng trung thành đó và các nghĩa vụ thể chế của bộ dường như kéo theo các hướng khác nhau.

segments.src: How that moment is handled, they say, tends to shape the rest of a tenure.
segments.tr: Họ nói rằng cách thức xử lý thời điểm đó có xu hướng định hình phần còn lại của nhiệm kỳ.

segments.src: ## A Divided Chamber, A Divided Reaction
segments.tr: ## Một phòng họp chia rẽ, một phản ứng chia rẽ

segments.src: Reaction on Capitol Hill broke along familiar lines.
segments.tr: Phản ứng trên Đồi Capitol diễn ra theo những hướng quen quen.

segments.src: Supporters of the confirmation pointed to Blanche's trial experience and argued that personal association with a president is not, on its own, disqualifying — noting that past attorneys general have also had prior political or personal ties to the administrations they served.
segments.tr: Những người ủng hộ việc chuẩn thuận chỉ ra kinh nghiệm xét xử của Blanche và lập luận rằng sự liên kết cá nhân với một tổng thống không phải là, tự thân nó, yếu tố loại bỏ — lưu ý rằng các tổng biện lý trước đây cũng có mối quan hệ chính trị hoặc cá nhân trước đó với các chính quyền mà họ phục vụ.

segments.src: Opponents maintained that the closeness of this particular relationship, combined with the unusually narrow vote, leaves the department starting its next chapter under a cloud of skepticism it did not choose and cannot easily dispel.
segments.tr: Những người phản đối duy trì rằng sự gần gũi của mối quan hệ đặc biệt này, kết hợp với cuộc bỏ phiếu bất thường là sít sao, khiến bộ bắt đầu chương tiếp theo dưới đám mây hoài nghi mà nó không chọn và không dễ dàng xua tan.

segments.src: For now, the numbers speak for themselves: a single vote, cast in the small hours of the morning, was enough to install Todd Blanche as the nation's chief law enforcement officer — and enough to leave Washington debating what that margin says about the office he now leads.
segments.tr: Hiện tại, các con số tự nói lên tất cả: một phiếu bầu duy nhất, được bỏ vào những giờ nhỏ của buổi sáng, là đủ để đưa Todd Blanche vào ghế quan chức thực thi pháp luật hàng đầu của quốc gia — và đủ để khiến Washington tranh luận về việc biên độ đó nói lên điều gì về văn phòng mà ông hiện đang lãnh đạo.
